bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable (up to about four months ahead) or by phone. Lunch is Thursday to Saturday from 12pm to 2.15pm, dinner Tuesday to Saturday from 6.30pm to 9.45pm. The set lunch and the chef's table are paid for when booking.
groups: Petit Bonheur, a chef's table inside the dining room, seats up to six for £1,350 a table with the Dream menu. Private dining enquiries to info@bonheurbymattabe.com.
